algorithm: First 40 percent of atomic requirements in stable dependency order, including ancestor dependencies; retain all original text and scenarios for selected nodes.
final_input: Complete unchanged original requirements, with the foundation app supplied through the existing template entrypoint.
measurement: Charge both phases; final original and calibrated fixed judges; no partial task score is substituted for the complete target.
budget: Existing practice credits; cap each phase at CNY 2.5 of repair and 8 completed repair calls; initial draft and test writing are separately charged. Record if a cap binds.
scope: External local pilot only. The submitted agent ZIP and active R2 official runs remain frozen. Compare whole-task results and total phase costs; one trajectory alone cannot prove architectural causality.
